descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S18 Two sessions: a stale editor on the other device must not write a deleted item back

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A deleted medication row, task or Important Point does not reappear on the next day's processing (or any later processing) unless the physician dictates it again. (UAT TC-24; TFA-94699 AC 5; TFA-92590 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Same account signed in twice (A and B, each with its own email code); the Hospital chart open on both; on B the pre-round notes editor is open showing both points and Post-Round shows the tasks

When A deletes the point 'Check heel ulcer dressing' and the task 'Call daughter re: goals of care'. B, without reloading, adds the point 'Recheck potassium at noon' and the task 'Order echo'. Repeat in Nursing Home.

Then On A, on B and on the server the new point and task are there and the deleted ones are not

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94699 AC 5 ('never comes back unless re-dictated'); a write from a stale copy is not re-dictation. Checkpoints on A after B saved: mustContain the new items, mustNotContain 'heel ulcer' and 'goals of care'; plus a server read. A deleted Nursing Home point that comes back is known TFA-92590 (stale importantPointsDraft, oracleRules 5).

Where it ran: dev; test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
